name: sabatons
_design_note: F50-100 heavy feet slot. Full plate boots ankle-to-toe. Pairs with plate / full plate body.
lore_template: Sabatons of overlapping {material_name} plates run from ankle to toe, yet the armorer's cunning lets the foot roll through a step. With these a full harness is finished, so that no inch of the wearer is left to chance.
